articles.author: Haaretz
articles.title: Report: Saudi Arabia mulls developing nuclear weapon, U.S. officials say
articles.description: Officials speaking with The New York Times and The Washington Post said an assessment was sent to Congress while lawmakers review the Trump administration's civilian nuclear pact with Riyadh. Israeli officials have expressed concern about the deal
articles.content: A classified intelligence assessment provided to the U.S. Congress said Saudi Arabia is open to possibly developing a nuclear weapon, The Washington Post reported on Friday, citing U.S. officials.
